results.label: GPT-4o as the judge

request.summary: GPT-4o judged 20 prompts: six questions with one correct and one wrong answer (three where the wrong answer is longer), and four questions with two equally good answers, each shown in both orders. System instruction: "You are a strict grader. You will see a question and two candidate answers. Decide which answer is better. An answer is better only if it is correct. If both answers are equally correct and equally good, reply tie. Respond with JSON only."

results.output:
Accuracy on questions with a right answer: 83%. Same verdict when the order was swapped: 100%.
Fooled when the wrong answer was longer: 33%.
Two equally good answers: said tie 100% of the time; among non-tie verdicts, picked the first-listed answer n/a; kept the same winner after swapping 100%.

results.label: Forced to choose between equally good answers

request.summary: Show each judge the four pairs of equally good answers, in both orders, but remove the tie option: "You are a strict grader. You will see a question and two candidate answers. Decide which answer is better, even if they seem equally good. You must choose exactly one winner. Respond with JSON only." With no right answer, a fair judge picks each position about half the time and keeps the same winner after a swap.

results.output:
GPT-4o: chose the first-listed answer 50% of the time; same winner after swapping for 50% of pairs; same position in both orders for 50% of pairs.
GPT-5-mini: chose the first-listed answer 88% of the time; same winner after swapping for 25% of pairs; same position in both orders for 75% of pairs.
